finalText:
I counted the feedback board on the GitPanel canvas by its sections. 60 stickies sit outside any section, each starting with "loose:". They repeat points that are already in the sections, so I counted each one under the theme it's about.

| # | Theme | Stickies | In its section | Loose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Onboarding** | **60** | 40 | 20 |
| 2 | **Export** | **56** | 36 | 20 |
| 3 | **Performance** | **50** | 40 | 10 |
| 4 | **Pricing** | **41** | 31 | 10 |
| 5 | **Done** (work already shipped) | **24** | 24 | 0 |

- **Most stickies repeat a point.** Each of the first four themes has only 10 separate points; the rest are copies marked "+1".
  - **Onboarding:** each point appears 6 times, for example "the first-run sign-in loops twice", "not clear what a project is" and "GitHub step asks for too much".
  - **Export:** the points with the most copies are "PDF export lost the fonts", "want JPG, not only PNG" and "exporting 40 artboards is slow", at 6 each.
- **Pricing** includes one locked sticky: "keep the student tier — decided with Tereza".
- **Done** is a list of finished work, not feedback. If you only want feedback themes, the fifth would be **Ideas**, with 5 stickies (poster set, match recap template, logo sting and others).
- Besides stickies, the board has 22 text notes, 15 shapes labelled Q1 to Q15, 20 arrows and one open pricing vote.

I didn't change anything on the canvas or the board. The only file I wrote is a copy of the board data in the session's scratch folder.
